title: Lone
summary: LONE, adjective 1. Solitary; retired; unfrequented; having no company. And leave you in lone woods or empty walls. 2. Single; standing by itself; not having others in the neighborhood; as a lone house

inlines.v: LONE, adjective 1. Solitary; retired; unfrequented; having no company. And leave you in lone woods or empty walls. 2. Single; standing by itself; not having others in the neighborhood; as a lone house. 3. Single; unmarried, or in widowhood. LONE, noun A lane. [Local.]
